title: Boots of Very Fast Blinking

sources.title: Disrobing Blinkstep
markers: | description = You teleport to an unoccupied space you can see. However, your clothes do not teleport with you.

summary: Once per turn, use a Bonus Action to teleport to a visible unoccupied space up to 60 ft away. Your clothes and armour stay behind.

fields.Effect: Once per turn, use a Bonus Action to teleport to a visible unoccupied space up to 60 ft away. Your clothes and armour stay behind.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence.
